content.short: Pluno automates responses to repetitive questions in Discord and Telegram communities.
content.description: Pluno is a community management tool that automates replies to repetitive questions in Discord and Telegram, surfaces unanswered queries, and delivers deeper insights into the questions the community asks most often. Used by teams including AAVE, Dune, Flashbots, and POAP, it helps save time, speed up responses, and better understand member needs, enabling teams to run more efficient, responsive communities.
